column1: # boru Language Specification: refine-of-flex retag + container predicates
# Format: input<TAB>expected<TAB>description
# Two of the pure-boru container-subtype enablers (FLEX-ATTRS.1 D4,
# design/OPEN-WORDS.1.md §7b):
#   1. A bare refine of a FLEX type retags flex handles through typed
#      def (`def w:S (flex m)`) — check and runtime agree; the tag
#      survives in-place writes because flex words return the receiver.
#   2. A fn-bodied capitalised def (`def Sorted ([m:Map] => [pred])`)
#      is a CONTENT-predicate type over containers; params dispatch on
#      the predicate. (Content types cannot ANCHOR extensions — the
#      OPEN-WORDS.1 §3.1 nominality rule — classification only.)
# (The third enabler — base-dispatch delegation for override bodies —
# is the `as` dispatch-ascription word; see OPEN-WORDS.1 §9 and
# lang/spec/as.tsv.)
# §1  refine-of-flex retag — nominal subtypes of mutable containers
def S (refine FlexMap)  def w:S (flex {b:2 a:1})  typeof w
column3: typed def retags a flex handle to the newtype (the flex-retag gap, fixed)

column1: def S (refine FlexMap)  def w:S (flex {b:2 a:1})  (set c/q 3 w) drop typeof w
column3: the tag survives an in-place write — flex words return the receiver handle

column1: def S (refine FlexMap)  def w:S (flex {b:2 a:1})  w

column1: def L (refine FlexList)  def v:L (flex [1 2])  typeof v
# §2  content-predicate types over containers (classification)
def Sorted ([m:Map] => [(keys m) deq (sort (keys m))])  def f fn [[m:Sorted] [Integer] [size m]]  f {a:1 b:2}
column3: a map satisfying the predicate dispatches the Sorted param

column1: def Sorted ([m:Map] => [(keys m) deq (sort (keys m))])  def f fn [[m:Sorted] [Integer] [size m]]  f (set a/q 1 (set b/q 2 { }))
column3: an unsorted map is declined at dispatch (content, not provenance)

column1: # §3  a refined container is eq to itself (NUR142): eq is identity for the container family — the same store under the same tag — and a refinement is a member of the family
def S (refine FlexMap)  def w:S (flex {a:1})  w eq w
column3: a refined flex map is eq to itself
